Registered Dietitian

Sound familiar?

Perfect all week. All out by Saturday. Day one again on Monday.

  • You know a lot about nutrition, and still feel like you’re either “on” or “off”.
  • A brunch, a birthday dinner or a night out turns into “I’ll start again Monday”.
  • You overthink every menu, then end up ordering whatever, because why bother.
  • You want to feel good in your body and still have a social life, without the extremes.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover live

Why the all-or-nothing cycle keeps restarting

Why strict weeks so often lead to all-out weekends, and what actually breaks the loop.

The end of the Monday reset

Why one meal or one night out doesn’t “undo” anything, and how to just carry on with your week.

How to order anywhere

A dietitian’s simple framework for menus, brunch, takeout and fast food, so you leave satisfied, not stressed.

Happy hour, the balanced way

How to build your plate and pace your night so you enjoy it and still feel good the next morning.

Table, plate, chair

The one strategy I teach to stop mindless grazing and eat more mindfully at home.

Meet Hailey

Hi, I’m Hailey Gorski, RD

I’m a Registered Dietitian and the founder of The Tipsy Kale, where wellness meets happy hour. I studied Nutrition and Dietetics at the University of Wisconsin-Madison and did my dietetic internship at Loyola University Chicago.

I believe nutrition should empower, not overwhelm. My whole approach is about moving from food extremes to food freedom, so healthy eating fits the life you actually want to live.

Questions

Before you reserve your seat

Why is it $17 and not free?

Because people who invest, even a little, show up and actually use what they learn. I want a room full of people who are ready to try something different.

Is this a diet?

No. There’s no meal plan to follow and nothing to cut out. It’s education on building a balanced relationship with food that fits your real life.

Is this medical advice?

No. The masterclass is educational content. For any personal medical needs, please speak with your own healthcare provider.

What if I can’t make it live?

Reserve your seat anyway. Every seat includes the full replay.

Will you talk about coaching at the end?

For the last few minutes I’ll share how to apply to work with me 1:1, for anyone who wants to go further. Everything before that is yours to use either way.

Script 1 · “The Monday reset”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“As a dietitian, here’s why ‘I’ll start again Monday’ never works.”

Body

“A strict week leads to an all-out weekend, which leads to another strict week. The food was never the problem. The extremes are. One meal doesn’t undo anything, and once that clicks, the cycle stops.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in The Food Freedom Happy Hour. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera at your vanity mirror, captions on, end card “Educational content, not medical advice”. Audience 21+ because of the happy hour references.

Script 2 · “Order anywhere”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s how a dietitian orders at brunch.”

Body

“I start with protein, add something fresh, then pick the thing I actually want, no guilt. That’s it. No extremes, no ‘being good’. It works at brunch, dinner out and takeout.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through the full framework live for $17, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: at a brunch table, menu in hand, on-screen text for each step. Your fast-food menu hack style, reused for the class.

Script 3 · “Wellness meets happy hour”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Being healthy and having a social life aren’t opposites.”

Body

“Wellness doesn’t mean skipping every dinner and saying no to every happy hour. It means having a plan you can live with. That’s how you go from food extremes to food freedom.”

CTA

“Join me live for The Food Freedom Happy Hour. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: getting ready to go out, then at the table, on-screen cards: Brunch · Dinner out · Happy hour. Audience 21+.
